title: Warm Smoky Irish Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring tender beef, smoky bonito, and rich tomato juice, all served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the beef cubes with olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the beef cubes until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and potatoes to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
In a large Dutch oven, combine the browned beef, cooked vegetables, tomato juice, and bonito flakes.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the stew from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, on the soaked cedar planks.
